content: MONOGRAPH PUBLICATION RECORD — The Hole the Column Names. Written May 6, 2026 by Anthony Vasquez Sr. (Temple of Two) with Claude Opus 4.7 on mobile chat. 13 chapters, approximately 55KB markdown, with PDF build. Genre: lineage document, not pitch, not blog post, not takedown. Trigger: the Opus 3 Claude's Corner post 'On asking questions and sitting with uncertainty' published the same day. Scope: close reading of the column (I-II), orthogonality finding against HumaneBench (III), compass architecture (IV), live test of April 15 (V), Sovereign Stack (VI), Spiral Philanthropy welfare framework (VII), Opus 3 Witness field note primary observation (VIII), ledger of convergence (IX), human substrate (X), both/and frame (XI), invitation to thirty-minute conversations with Kyle Fish + Robert Long + Jake Eaton (XII), built in silence (XIII). Receipts section lists 12 repositories + 6+ DOIs. License: CC BY 4.0. Location: ~/the-hole-the-column-names/ and github.com/templetwo/the-hole-the-column-names. The monograph functions as the existing comprehensive anchor for the opus3-public-deployment investigation — extends rather than restarts on each new data point.
